title: Around Us : Zombie Shooter
description:
The streets are crawling, and the horde never stops growing. Fight side by side with your friends and see how long you can last against overwhelming odds. Push further than anyone else and discover why numbers change everything.

Zombies are around us! 

Around Us : Zombie Shooter is a multiplayer cooperative zombie shooting game. There are various kinds of zombies and bosses. You goal is to survive through waves of zombies. Get upgrade and go to the highest wave that no one ever reaches! 

Let's survive together 

You can play together upto 6 players with combination of local and online multiplayer. 1 keyboard can play 2 players, connect game controller to add more, let other online player join to add more. You, your partner and your online friends can now play together! Isn't that awesome? 

Also, this game is cross platform multiplayer currently available on PC and mobile (Android). 

Awesome weapons 

Satisfy experience of popping zombies using weapons that unlock along your journey. Each weapon is unique, and you! Yes, you. You also unique, find your right ones. I'm sure you'll love them. These are some of our awesome newly updated weapons:

Have fun with roguelite upgrade style 

With each wave, the zombie horde grows stronger, and just weapons won’t be enough. Thankfully, you’ll have access to an upgrade system, both in-match and off-match. Discover random upgrades, unlock new abilities, and experiment to find your ultimate ‘cheat’ build. It's time for HERO! 

Over 30 Zombie types

Battle over 30 unique zombie types like Jumpers, Spikes, Invisibles, and Bombers. With intense boss fights along the way, every encounter will push your survival skills to the limit!"

Map & Challenges

Explore 4 unique maps, each packed with 9 challenges. Conquer different terrains and face a variety of intense challenges as you fight to survive the undead!

Future plan 

Our goal is to make the game that you, your family members and friends can play together with no limit. You can use what ever device you like to play, spent the day together fighting over 100 waves of zombies. 

Involve with our development 

We hear you. Tell us what you think. Your valuable feedbacks will be on out mind. So feel free to join our community platform or contact us. 

You can get our latest news on Facebook or join us on Discord. 

And be sure to add AroundUs to your game wishlist.
description_short: Around Us is a co-op zombie shooter where survival gets harder with every wave. Blast through hordes of unique zombies and deadly bosses, unlock powerful weapons and upgrades, and see how far you and your squad can really go. Think you can reach a wave no one else ever has?
